status: Technical follow-up fixed before recomputed validation and before generation of the new test sets; not external preregistration
weight_rule: Use average finite-shot calibration outcome variances, independently of final query outcomes. Estimate each Pauli outcome variance by n/(n-1)*(1-observed_mean^2), average across the 64 calibration channels, then clip to [0,1]. Pool X and Y for known-Z dephasing. Query-mean proxy is sum(v_cal_P/n_query_P)/16. Pilot counts may depend on the independent pilot, never on final-stage outcomes. Same proxy for every prior. No oracle expectations, extra labels or new fusion-fitting shots.
calibration: Reuse 20 disjoint groups of 64 examples, 64 shots per label and the same five label-outcome streams as stage2 (one bath) and stage4 (two baths). Residual prior second moments and all other estimator components unchanged. Total 4096 offline shots per fitted prior.
validation: Reuse original physical validation sets and original validation query random streams, rerunning the complete same grid for legacy and independent weights. Select only independent-weight estimators. Preserve legacy validation side by side as diagnostic evidence.
selection: Separately select DFE, constant, ridge and neural at minimum positive query shots, then offline cost, guard score and allocation; same original 1.645 variance-component guard. Do not strengthen guard in response to test outcomes. Also report zero-query priors.
test_order: Lock all per-class selections with design, code and validation hashes before generating each new test. Check overlap against previous calibration, validation and both earlier tests. No budget replacement after test access.
inference: 4000 shared crossed/hierarchical bootstrap draws. Per physical family, one six-comparison family: neural minus DFE, constant and ridge at each of two headline targets. Bonferroni one-sided upper quantile 1-0.05/6, including absent comparisons in the fixed divisor. The two-bath non-neural family uses ridge minus DFE and constant at two targets, divisor four. No familywise claim across physical families. Report pointwise 95% mean-risk intervals and one-sided 95% target checks separately.
secondary: Same-budget legacy-versus-independent comparisons at ZZ known-Z budgets 20 and 36 and fixed-allocation budgets 3,4,6,8,12,20,36 for one-bath exchange, or 4,8,12,20,36 for two baths. Paired outcomes. Diagnostic comparisons and target sweeps are exploratory, outside the primary family.
deployment_variability: Report empirical single-fit MAE percentiles and target fractions. Do not interpret shared-query, shared-checkpoint fits as independent Bernoulli deployment trials.
preservation: Do not modify old designs, results or published release. No neural retraining, new architecture claims, new bath audit or new review response. Public code/data only if publishing an updated version.
